inputs.checklistItemText: Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors not included on building elevation sheets to demonstrate required clearances are met
inputs.question: Are there any building elevation sheets shown in this site plan set that display surveyed overhead conductor locations and elevations with clearance dimensions?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether building elevation sheets exist in the plan set and whether they display overhead conductor information — this is a sheet-discovery and document-presence check, not a measurement or drawing-inspection task. The actual clearance verification (measurement) would come only after confirming these sheets are present.
